title: Find the first wrong row estimate

cast.name: Mira
cast.role: Curious junior engineer who states the plausible wrong assumption

cast.name: Dev
cast.role: Calm staff engineer who asks for evidence and explains the mechanism

glossary.full: Execute a plan and report actual rows and timing
glossary.note: It runs the statement; use care with commands that change data.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Interview day. Mira circles an orders query. Dev hides the proposed index.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: Customer_id is the filter. I would add an index and go home early.

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: Maybe. Before choosing, ask the planner what it expected and compare that estimate with what execution observed.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: The command is EXPLAIN ANALYZE. It only improves the estimate without running my query, right?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: It executes the statement and reports actual work. Start with a safe SELECT; writes can have side effects.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: Then I compare estimated and actual rows at each plan node, beginning at the leaves?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: Yes. Find the first large mismatch; lower estimates shape higher join choices.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: And repeated nodes show actual row counts as totals across every loop?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: Rows and times are per-loop averages. Multiply by loops; parent times include their children.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: If the estimate is wrong, should I force the index and end the investigation?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: Refresh stale statistics with ANALYZE, then rerun. If estimates stay wrong, investigate the data distribution.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: Fine. I will mark the first mismatch and test its cause before spending our interview budget on indexes.

key_points: EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the statement; use extra care with data-changing commands.
Compare estimated and actual rows from the plan leaves upward; repeated-node actual rows are per-loop averages.
Refresh relevant statistics and remeasure before forcing a plan choice.
